description: This file contains partial class definitions, extension methods, and configuration options related to DynamoDB reminders in the Orleans framework. It defines options classes for DynamoDB storage, extension methods for service registration, and client options for DynamoDB credentials.

classes.name: DynamoDBReminderStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for DynamoDB reminder storage, including capacity units, table name, and flags for creation and update behaviors.

classes.name: DynamoDBReminderTableOptions
classes.description: Options class for DynamoDB reminder table, including connection string with redaction attribute.

classes.name: DynamoDBClientOptions
classes.description: Client options for DynamoDB credentials and service configuration, including access key, secret key, profile, token, and service name.

methods.name: ParseConnectionString
methods.description: Extension method to parse a connection string into DynamoDBReminderStorageOptions.

methods.name: UseDynamoDBReminderService
methods.description: Extension method to add DynamoDB reminder service to the service collection or silo builder with configuration options.
